about: Public keys published on this site. Public halves only: no private key, vault key or token is ever listed here. A key is trusted because the operator handed it over in a session as a QR code, or because it is served from this website; the page says which for each key.

keys.label: DC Vault Registry (the vault of vaults)
keys.role: The agent that keeps the team's vault keys. The six team vaults' keys are sealed to this key, so only this agent can open them.
